title: IoT-Based Multi-Parameter Water Quality Monitoring System Using LoRa Telemetry
abstract: Design and field implementation of an energy efficient long range wireless telemetry station measuring water pH, TDS, and turbidity in agricultural irrigation canals.

title: Real-Time Air Quality and Carbon Monoxide Telemetry Using Edge Filtering
abstract: Development of a compact sensor node capable of real time air particulate and carbon monoxide estimation with moving average calibration running locally on microcontroller firmware.

title: Web-Based Spatial Dashboard for River Water Quality Index Visualization
abstract: Interactive geographic information system displaying historical and real time river quality indices derived from decentralized telemetry nodes across the Kudus river basin.

title: Machine Learning-Based Short-Term Anomaly Detection for Hydroponic Nutrient Sensors
abstract: Investigating lightweight anomaly detection models (Isolation Forest and Autoencoders) to flag drifting pH and electrical conductivity sensor readings in closed loop hydroponic systems.
